themes.name: Fit, size, and silhouette confidence
themes.description: Investigate whether still-interested wishlist revisitors can confidently choose a variant.

themes.name: Material, quality, and visual confidence
themes.description: Investigate whether current product evidence is trusted and personally diagnostic.

themes.name: Comparison and decision-resume effort
themes.description: Investigate whether revisiting saved products requires shoppers to reconstruct comparisons and prior reasoning.

themes.name: Return and post-purchase risk
themes.description: Investigate whether uncertainty about returns, refunds, or product mismatch delays otherwise active decisions.

segments.name: Still-interested wishlist revisitor
segments.description: A behavior-based candidate group for later evidence review and interviews.

segments.name: Comparison-led revisitor
segments.description: A candidate group that may keep several saved options active while reconstructing comparisons.

segments.name: Fit-confidence seeker
segments.description: A candidate group that may remain interested but lack enough evidence to select size or silhouette.

segments.name: Risk-sensitive decider
segments.description: A candidate group that may delay when product mismatch or return effort feels difficult to reverse.
